equipment_type: Absorption chiller, steam or hot water (via SC-EQ card)
applies_to: YORK YIA steam- or hot-water-fired absorption chillers fitted with the SC-EQ communication card.
summary: The YIA's SC-EQ card puts the absorption chiller on a BACnet MS/TP trunk (it also speaks Modbus RTU and N2). The BAS can run/stop the chiller and write the leaving chilled water setpoint and load limit. Read-only points cover chilled and condenser water temperatures, generator and purge pressures, strong solution temperature and concentration, steam or hot water supply values, pump status and multistate operation, shutdown, warning and inhibit codes.
notes: Access is inferred: the sheet has no read/write column. The remote block (AV 1-2, BV 1) is treated as commandable; everything else as read-only.

Status-code MVs (MV 1-4, MV 6-8) are the printed code + 1, as the doc's status code tables say. MV 5 is shown as printed, from 0; BACnet multistate values start at 1, so the card may report the printed number + 1. Confirm by discovery.
Steam supply pressure only applies to steam units; generator and purge pressures are in mmHg.
This list has no MV 65001 Units object and no AV copies of the code MVs.
Spare objects (AV 3-4, BV 2-4 and the empty rows) are left out.

integration.summary: Wire the BAS to the SC-EQ RS-485 port and set the MAC address; the card detects BACnet MS/TP. Run/stop the chiller with BV 1 and write the leaving chilled water setpoint (AV 1) and load limit (AV 2). Read MV 1 for the operating state, the chilled water temperatures and MV 2/MV 3 for safety and cycling shutdowns. MV 5 shows whether the chiller is under ISN (BAS) control.

minimum_points.name: UNIT CONTROL SOURCE
minimum_points.why: Control source; ISN (BAS) for BMS control

integration.enable: BV 1 REM RUN STOP CMD (0 = Stop, 1 = Run) is the BAS run/stop; AV 1 and AV 2 are the remote setpoints. MV 5 shows the control source (Local, ISN, Analog, Digital); it should read ISN for BAS control. The points list has no write-enable point.
setup: The BAS connects to the SC-EQ J12 port (RS-485: +, -, COM/REF, SHLD). The card detects BACnet MS/TP, Modbus RTU or N2 and the baud rate by itself; allow up to 120 seconds after power-up.
The MAC address (1-127) is set on DIP switch SW1 (switch 8 unused). Cycle the card's power after changing it.

The device instance defaults to 5000 + the MAC address (MAC 6 gives 5006). To use another number, set Device Instance Mode to Manual and enter the instance with the SC-AP / MAP tool, or write BV 65000 (mode) and AV 65000 (instance ID).
gotchas: The remote (commandable) setpoints read as unreliable until the BAS writes them the first time.
The SC-EQ only exposes the points that apply to the chiller it detects; if it replaces an E-Link, re-discover the device so old non-applicable points don't sit offline.
The safety code table (SC.2, MV 2) has several crystallization-check and dilution-cycle faults, and the control status code (SC.12, MV 6) shows when a dilution cycle is running.

points.name: CYCLING SHUTDOWN CODE
points.states: 1=No Cycling Faults Present, 2=Power Failure Ocurred, 3=Low Leaving Chilled Liquid Temperature, 4=Unit Shutdown by Remote Device, 5=Unit Shutdown by Multi-Unit Remote, 6=Daily Schedule Programmed Stop, 7=Emergency Power Source Activated

points.name: WARNING MESSAGE CODE

Condition, 15=ADC in Progress -Load set to 50%-, 16=Primary Limited ADC in Progress - Load set to 50%-, 17=Secondary Limited ADC in Progress, 18=Unit in Standby Until Power Supply Recovers, 19=Unit is Unable to Perform a Limited Dilution Cycle, 20=Primary Limited ADC in Progress - Load set to 50%-

points.name: UNIT INHIBIT FAULT CODE
points.states: 1=No Inhibit Faults Present, 2=Generator hi-press Analog Switch PT1 >672 mmHg, 3=Low Refrigerant Temp Analog RT8 < 33F (0.56C), 4=Auxiliary TB1-31 Device Opened, 5=Leaving Chilled Liquid Temp < Setpoint, 6=Unit Shutdown by Remote Device, 7=HW Valve Loaded>10% Close to <9% to Restart, 8=Steam Valve Loaded >10% Close to <9% to Restart, 9=Unit Shutdown by Multi-Unit Remote
